data.title: Trap from the Warp: New War Robot, Weapon, Wrap & Events
data.meta_title: Trap from the Warp: New War Robot, Weapon, Wrap & Events
data.content:
Step into the web of the latest September update—fresh and bold like a pumpkin spice latte. Discover Kumo, the FreeCon War Robot that strikes from the Warp, unleash the new Horde Heavy Shotgun, and claim the radiant Gemwrath Animated Wrap. Test your mettle in the revamped Last Robot Standing mode with powerful team-wide boosts, seize upgrade discounts, and don’t forget to grab the community-made Raptor's Attack Sticker with the exclusive promo code.

KUMO: ATTACK FROM WARP WITH A NEW WAR ROBOT & WEAPON

  • War Robot Model: Kumo
  • Class: Defender
  • Dominion: FreeCon

Meanwhile, waking up on Tortuga for the first time during all that kerfuffle, Carmen Ruiz  is fascinated by the secrets hidden in Tortuga's coffers. To earn pilots trust, she volunteers to decipher location of another FreeCon weapon cache by following encrypted records in Tortuga's Solidus. Her search proves successful—leading her to a War Robot unseen by any other pilot.

Patient as a spider, Kumo weaves its web from stillness and stealth—don’t rush, just wait for the moment. When that moment comes, support your allies and boost their damage resistance. The rest of the time? Slowly push through enemy defenses or reinforce your own lines.

Equip Kumo with the new Horde Weapon, the Heavy Shotgun—an energy double-barrel weapon that fires a diverging blast of plasma. It’s perfect for the front line of assault. And don’t expect that front line to be out of reach—use WarpArmor (Core Gear). This ability lets the robot teleport to a chosen point and gives itself and nearby allies damage resistance for a few seconds.

Kumo is now available in the Store and Daily Deals.

ANIMATED WRAP: GEMWRATH (SEPTEMBER 23–OCTOBER 7)

The Gemwrath Animated Wrap turns your War Robots into a masterpiece of warcraft. This armor shimmers with a scatter of diamonds, framed by golden details worthy of master jewelers. But this is no ceremonial regalia—this radiant warplate is a living monument to the glory carved by War Robot and its Pilot on the battlefield.

The Gemwrath Wrap is now available in the Store.

 

UPDATED LAST ROBOT STANDING MODE (SEPTEMBER 23)

Game Modes Last Robot Standing+ permanently replaces the old Last Robot Standing mode in Ranked Play. The new ruleset includes the following power-ups:

  • Shield: Provides shield for the whole team that picks it up, regenerating 2000 per second.
  • Mass Regeneration: Regenerates 20000 armor of each Module for the whole team that picks it up.
  • Mass Armor: Increases damage resistance by 20% for the whole team that picks it up.
  • Mass Fuel: Increases restoration speed of fuel by 15% for the whole team that picks it up.
  • Mass Speed: Increases acceleration by 30% and speed by 20% for the whole team that picks it up.
  • Mass Ultimate: Adds a 150 points charge to Cycle Gear for the whole team that picks it up.

INTEL UPGRADE DISCOUNT EVENT (SEPTEMBER 23–30)

It’s time to upgrade! Until September 30, the Intel cost for upgrading will be reduced. Check out the discounted items below:

  • War Robot Modules: Orochi, Ravana, Fenrir 
  • Weapons: Zeus, Fowler, Magneto
  • Gear: Blast Wave, Recon Mode, Quick Repair, Reflector, Sprint Reactor, Nanite Repair

WAR ROBOT MODULES (COMMON UPGRADES)

  • Level 3: 6 Intel (Previously 20 Intel)
  • Level 5: 12 Intel (Previously 40 Intel)
  • Level 9: 33 Intel (Previously 110 Intel)
  • Level 13: 100 Intel (Previously 230 Intel)

WAR ROBOT MODULES (UNCOMMON UPGRADES)

  • Level 3: 9 Intel (Previously 30 Intel)
  • Level 5: 18 Intel (Previously 60 Intel)
  • Level 9: 50 Intel (Previously 165 Intel)
  • Level 13: 150 Intel (Previously 345 Intel)

WAR ROBOT MODULES (RARE UPGRADES)

  • Level 3: 12 Intel (Previously 40 Intel)
  • Level 5: 24 Intel (Previously 80 Intel)
  • Level 9: 66 Intel (Previously 220 Intel)
  • Level 13:200 Intel (Previously 460 Intel)

FROM PLAYERS, FOR PLAYERS 

Claim your prize sticker, created by the winner of the community contest—t.rexoraptor’s Sticker is now in the game! A mark of victory, this sticker carries the spirit of its creator and adds a spark of triumph to every battle. Promocode — STICKERAPTOR (redeem it on the Promo Codes page).
